title: feedback-mppi: fast sampling-based mpc via rollout differentiation – adios low-level controllers
core_idea: Augment standard MPPI by computing local linear feedback gains through sensitivity analysis (rollout differentiation) inspired by Riccati-based feedback, enabling rapid closed-loop corrections around the current state without full re-optimization at each timestep to make sampling-based MPC suitable for real-time, high-frequency robotic control.
tldr: Introduce F-MPPI: compute local feedback gains via rollout differentiation to provide fast closed-loop corrections for real-time sampling-based MPC on complex robotic systems.
